title: Velocity at liquid exit
description: Essential: Correctly computes the speed when the rod leaves the liquid using energy conservation or kinematics (v = sqrt(2gH)).

title: Ampere force expression
description: Important: States the magnetic force on the rod as F = BIL, with correct identification of length L.

title: Work-energy balance
description: Essential: Applies work-energy theorem: work done by Ampere force (BIh) equals gain in gravitational potential energy (mg(H+h)).

title: Current calculation
description: Essential: Solves the work-energy equation correctly to find the constant current I.

title: Impulse-momentum setup
description: Important: For part (3), writes the impulse-momentum equation: (BIL - mg)t' = mv' - 0.

title: Second velocity relation
description: Important: Relates the new jump height H' to the exit velocity v' via v' = sqrt(2gH').

title: Charge from current integral
description: Essential: Recognizes that charge q = I' t', where I' is the (possibly non-constant) average current during t'.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong sign for gravity in force balance or impulse equation, or misplaces parentheses in energy equation.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Converts all lengths to meters and mass to kg consistently before numerical substitution.
